description: Multi-Tenant Phase 4F (revised in Phase 4F.1 for Blob-backed storage) -- the canonical tenant_config:v1 record shape. Both dashboard/api/_lib/tenantConfigStore.js (Node) and tenant_config_store.py (Python) write and read the literal SAME Upstash Redis hash; this fixture is the shared contract both languages' test suites (tests/test_tenant_config_store.js and tests/test_tenant_config_store.py) validate their own default-producing function against, so the two can never silently drift apart without a test failing on whichever side changed.
notes: configVersion starts at 1 after the first write (0 means 'no record exists yet') and is not listed in defaultValues because its value depends on write count, not a fixed default -- see each language's own upsert function. storageMode defaults to 'BLOB' because every tenant getting its FIRST record via either language's upsert function is a new, self-service tenant -- the only architecture new tenants are provisioned under (Phase 4F.1). LEGACY_REPO is reserved for Los Tres Amigos's pre-existing, git-committed/bundled data and is never assigned by either language's default-record logic.
